claim.claim: The service provider delivered the approved project report without the mandatory supporting evidence promised in the signed scope of work.
claim.requested_remedy: Provide the missing supporting evidence files and a corrected report with reproducible source references.
claim.claim_evidence: The original signed scope required source references, but the submitted deliverable has no attached evidence bundle.

response.response: The project report was submitted on time, but we dispute that supporting files were required in the agreed version.
response.response_evidence: The delivery confirmation mentions the report attachment only; we have no earlier evidence-bundle receipt.

remedy_action: We prepared a corrected report with stable source references and attached the previously omitted evidence bundle for the claimant to review.

remedy_evidence.description: A corrected report with the required source references stored in a signed, content-addressed archive.
The internal delivery receipt records the new evidence bundle transfer to the claimant.
